# Futty – Playtomic Features to Borrow

As of 7 November 2026 (rows 6, 7 and 17 and club row 6 updated to the 7 November decisions in 13) · Owner: Anghelo · Research from Playtomic's own help centres, App Store listing and club pages (sources at the end)

**Playtomic's best ideas for Futty are the ones that fill empty slots and settle disputes without staff: auto-generated open games, a one-tap result confirmation that auto-confirms after 24 hours, a level with a reliability score, recurring weekly bookings, and alerts when a slot frees up.** Five small ones fit into the 20 November build; the big ones should be the first things built after launch. Playtomic's weakest point, support, is where Futty's after-sales service can beat it.

## 1\. Playtomic today, in numbers

Playtomic's own club page claims 6,700+ clubs, 25,000+ courts, 1.7M+ monthly active players, 4M+ registered users, 1.5M+ monthly transactions and 63+ countries. It covers padel, tennis and pickleball; leagues are padel and tennis only. The iOS app is rated 4.8 from about 14,000 ratings. Its Trustpilot score is 1.3 from 138 reviews, almost all about support, refunds and charges.

The lesson: players like the product and hate the support. That's the gap to aim at.

## 2\. Player app features

| \# | Playtomic feature | How it works at Playtomic | Futty version | Track | When |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | Result confirmation | One player uploads the score; one opponent accepts and it's valid at once; if nobody responds it auto-validates after 24 hours; a rejection suspends it until re-entered | Replace the current "both sides submit matching scores, 3 attempts" logic. One captain submits, the other accepts or rejects, silence confirms after 24 hours. Fixes the "silence \= void" problem | A | Launch (simplifies A2) |
| 2 | Level with reliability | Levels 0–7. A one-time questionnaire sets the start. After each competitive match the level moves based on result, opponents' levels, partner's level and reliability. Low reliability means big swings; it grows with competitive matches. A coach session at a "leveling club" sets reliability to 50% | Already planned (A5). Add a visible reliability % and use it to size level changes | A | Launch |
| 3 | Competitive vs casual | Players choose per match; only competitive matches change levels | A toggle when booking or posting: "Competitive (counts for level)" or "Casual" | A | Launch (small) |
| 4 | Open matches for every free slot | Generated automatically for all open slots; the first player's level sets the range (0.25 below to 0.75 above); players outside it can ask, and one rejection blocks them; the court is reserved once enough people commit (for padel: 2 players more than 12 hours before, 3 more than 4 hours before, always at 4); otherwise cancelled and refunded | "Open games": every free slot at a partner venue becomes a joinable 5-a-side. Individuals join and pay their share; the pitch is reserved once a threshold is reached (for example 6 of 10 players more than 24 hours before); otherwise cancelled and refunded automatically. This is what fills venues' empty off-peak slots | P (bookings) \+ A (levels) | First after launch |
| 5 | No-show policy | No-show \= didn't attend and didn't cancel 24+ hours before. Charged the court fee as a debt that blocks the app until paid. Reported by a player who attended, within 7 days. The match is voided for levels | Under "split", a no-show has already paid. Use QR check-in to record no-shows automatically and show a turn-up rate on profiles. For open games, adopt the 24-hour rule | A (check-in) \+ P (debt) | Launch: turn-up rate. After launch: open-game rule |
| 6 | Split payment, booker covers the rest | Each player pays a share; unpaid shares charged to the booker 2 hours after the match, or become a debt | Adopted and extended (13): three booking modes; unpaid amounts come from the booker's guarantee (responsible mode) or become the player's debt to the venue (just my spot); short games are split among the players who joined | P | Launch |
| 7 | Cancellation rules | Players can leave an open match until 24 hours before; after that only the club can act. Refunds to the original payment method automatically; club wallet refunds are instant | Decided 7 November (13): free within 1 hour of paying, then €1 kept and the rest as venue credit until 6 hours before kickoff, then no refund; the same at every venue. Show the next cutoff on the booking card with a countdown | P | Launch |
| 8 | Recurring bookings | Staff create a weekly series; each booking appears to players to accept and pay | "Same time every week": a booker reserves a weekly slot for N weeks, each week's game is paid separately. Football regulars play weekly, so this drives the rebook number | P | Launch: one-tap "rebook next week". Series: first after launch |
| 9 | Priority alerts (Premium) | Notifications for last-minute spots and free courts | "Notify me if this slot opens" on full slots; when a booking is cancelled, alert the waiting list first | P \+ A (notifications) | First after launch |
| 10 | Leagues | Club-run; groups with promotion and relegation by one group; matches scheduled automatically from court availability; players reschedule in the app from a calendar of free slots and confirm with the other team; two points models | Extend Futty leagues: divisions with promotion and relegation, auto-scheduling from the venue's free pitches, in-app rescheduling | A | After launch (January) |
| 11 | Tournaments | Filter "tournaments I can play" by level and gender; enrol singly or with a partner; auto-cancelled with full refund if minimum entries aren't reached | One-day 5-a-side cups run by venues: team entry fee, minimum teams, automatic refund if it doesn't fill, a bracket. Revenue for venues and Futty | P (payments) \+ A (brackets) | After launch |
| 12 | Profile | Level per sport and a level graph, match list, wins and losses with win %, preferences (hand, position, match type, preferred days and times), players you play with most, clubs you've played at | Add preferences (position, foot, preferred days and times) to power "Need players" suggestions, and "players you play with most" for one-tap invites | A | Launch (small) |
| 13 | Find players and follow | Recommendations of players at your club or nearby; follow players | Already have follows. Add "players at your level near you" suggestions | A | After launch |
| 14 | Match chat | Every match has a chat; supervised by the club and Playtomic support; mute and block | Extend the existing fixture chat to every booking and open game, with mute and block | A | Launch if time; otherwise after |
| 15 | Community matches | Organise a match at a court not on Playtomic; the organiser collects money; phone verification required to create or join | "Games at other pitches": log games at venues not on Futty so stats and levels still count. Builds a player network in Limassol before venues there sign | A | After launch |
| 16 | Phone verification | Required to create or join community matches (added in September 2026\) | Verify phone numbers before joining paid games or posting "Need opposition": cuts fake accounts and no-shows | P | Launch (small) |
| 17 | Premium | No booking fees, priority alerts, "Golden Matches" visibility, automatic court assignment, advanced stats (set-level data, longest winning streak, toughest opponent, comparisons) | At launch (decided): €3.99 a month, no Futty fee on the player's own spot, book 14 days ahead instead of 7. Later: priority alerts, boosted opposition posts, advanced stats | P (billing) \+ A (stats) | Launch (core); extras after |
| 18 | Experiences and challenges | Released October 2026: sports trips and camps; virtual challenges tracked on your profile | Monthly challenges ("play 4 games in November", "score in 3 games in a row") with badges. Skip trips | A | After launch |

| 10 | Plan tiers for clubs (Standard, Professional, Champion, Master) | The future paid venue dashboard: free listing, paid tier with reports, memberships, leagues | — | 2027 |

## 4\. What Playtomic does badly: our opening

From its Trustpilot reviews (a complaints-heavy sample, but consistent):

| Complaint | Futty's answer |
| :---- | :---- |
| Support is bots; tickets closed without help; slow replies | A named human per venue on WhatsApp, reply within an hour in the evening (07 Venues) |
| Refunds refused or redirected to the club; unclear rules | One refund table, shown before payment, applied automatically (03) |
| Charges and fines that feel unfair (for example no-show charges when ill) | Clear rules up front; a goodwill exception the founders can grant |
| Unpaid shares blocking new bookings | Keep the debt rule (decided 7 November: debt to any venue blocks booking anywhere on Futty) and explain it before booking, with a one-tap "Pay what I owe" |
| Minimum level required to make casual matches public | Don't gate casual games by level |

## 5\. What to add to the 20 November build

Only the small ones; the launch scope is already tight:

- [ ] Result confirmation: one submits, the other accepts or rejects, auto-confirm after 24 hours (inside A2)  
- [ ] Competitive or casual toggle (inside A5)  
- [ ] Reliability % on levels (inside A5)  
- [ ] Profile preferences and "players you play with most" (inside A3)  
- [ ] Phone verification before paid games and opposition posts (inside P4 or P5)  
- [ ] Staff roles in the venue dashboard and auto pitch assignment (inside P3 and P6)  
- [ ] Booking card countdown to the cancellation deadline (inside P5)

## 6\. First things after launch, in order

1. Open games for every free slot (the venue pitch: "we fill your empty slots")  
2. "Notify me if this slot opens" waiting list  
3. Weekly recurring bookings  
4. Retention notifications (win-back, rate the venue)  
5. Leagues with divisions, auto-scheduling and rescheduling  
6. Venue tournaments  
7. Games at other pitches (prepares Limassol)  
8. Premium and challenges
